glosses: To agree with; to closely follow.

examples.text: Entries in English dictionaries aim to reflect common usage.

glosses: To give evidence of someone's or something's character etc.

examples.text: The team's victory reflects the Captain's abilities.

The admirable smoothness of the riding also reflected the greatest credit on those who, despite the difficulties caused by the shortage of men and materials, have succeeded in maintaining the track in such first-class order.

glosses: To think seriously; to ponder or consider.

examples.text: People do that sort of thing every day, without ever stopping to reflect on the consequences.
